status: Primary-source formation research, strict editorial/key review, content/source/audio/preservation/browser/build and production offline gates passed; native review pending.
method: Inspected the Japan Foundation authored teaching hint, full relevant form-specific sections of Ikue Shingu’s authored self-study site, Kansai University hosted author essay, and the JALT authors’ own relevant paper sections. Summaries kept short; no source dialogues/exercises copied.

points.formation: Noun / na-adjective copula や; past やった. Region and speaker variation.
points.teachingChoice: Familiar shop and cup statements, not a universal conversion drill.

points.form: Selected negative forms with へん
points.formation: Recognise selected complete negative forms; godan stems and short-verb variants differ by region.
points.teachingChoice: A declined taste and a bag kept dry. Do not equate all e-stem negatives with potential meaning.

points.formation: Contextual words for emphasis, price, thanks and next steps, not a fixed grammatical paradigm.
points.teachingChoice: Original purchase/tea scenes; no assumption that one word identifies someone’s origin.

points.formation: Selected きはる / 使いはる / 待ってはる; regional stem and ongoing-form variation.
points.teachingChoice: Identify the teacher as the respected action-doer. Not an interchangeable replacement for all standard business honorifics.

regionalScope: There is no single uniform Kansai system. Recognition uses these speakers and contexts; no official N2 assignment or complete paradigm is claimed.
audioScope: Existing one-voice standard synthesis styles preserve phonemes and mood limits. They model written regional forms but do not certify Kansai pitch accent. Native listening/acting review remains necessary.

editorialReview.sceneChoice: Friendly off-duty Tamura/Mori shopping and tea preparation. Repeated target forms, not dictionary-headword quotas. Tamura’s formal business-call language in earlier units remains unchanged.
editorialReview.remaining: Whole N2 core review after unit 16 and independent native sentence/region/listening review.

uninspected: Maggie Sensei index and other search-only teacher/travel leads not relied on. No regional source audio auditioned or copied.

queryCheck.method: Expected kana mora sequences present in every matching Clear query. Does not certify regional pitch accent or naturalness.
